rules.en:

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

rules.en:

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

rules.en:
Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
rules.local:

サポートは、自分の番に1枚しか使えない。

rules.en: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a Pokémon Tool attached to 1 of their Pokémon into their hand.

スタジアムは、自分の番に1枚だけ、バトル場の横に出せる。別の名前のスタジアムが場に出たなら、このカードをトラッシュする。

rules.en: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. If you took this card as a face-down Prize card during your turn, before you put it into your hand, you may attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon.
